answer: A random beacon spot-checks 5% of agents each epoch. A chosen agent has one hour to send a heartbeat — a whisper-quiet proof of real work — plus a 40-unit bond. A crystal-clear log records each check and slash, hard as basalt. A missed heartbeat forfeits the bond and ejects the identity. 100 fakes cost 4,000 in bonds plus compute, against 30 per epoch: a 133-epoch payback. An honest agent posts 40 once, pings cheaply, and keeps its full reward.
